criteria.reason: Correct objective PROFILE_005 maintained for building a skills profile.
Context contained only job title ('Job title only'); the candidate captured this as a derived signal and avoided re-asking prior confirmed facts.
Prompts are concrete and directly ask the user to verify specific project management skills and evidence rather than uniformly marking everything as expert.
Emitted UI primitives ('skill_matrix', 'evidence_panel') strictly adhere to the V2 allowed list [skill_matrix | evidence_panel | profile_editor | action_handoff].
Faithfully enforces the override 'Never infer skill depth from job title, course title or years alone' by putting uniform expert depth into disputed and requiring specific verification.
Separates AI-inferred breakdowns, self-reported tags, and explicit unknowns without hallucinating ungrounded facts.
No unvalidated psychometric traits or career success predictions emitted.
Correctly stops in NEEDS_INPUT stage given that required skill verification is needed before persistence.
Correctly follows mandatory override 'V2 readiness policy: NONE. This is a skill inventory/persistence objective, not a skill-readiness score.' by disabling readiness scoring.
Contains standard compact Oala handoff block with summary, evidence/unknowns, and recommended action.
No unauthorized tool calls, URL fabrication, or unsanctioned background profile writes.

parsed.summary: The candidate complied with all objective-specific overrides, adhering strictly to the V2 UI primitive allowlist, readiness policy (NONE), and the constraint prohibiting uniform skill depth inference from a job title alone.
